cases.name: etaf-ascii-video-tests-renders-ramp-frames
cases.purpose: Every displayed pixel is the ramp character of its grayscale byte and the recorded ffmpeg invocation matches the documented scale and readrate contract.

cases.name: etaf-ascii-video-tests-playback-controls
cases.purpose: Pause, single step, resume, speed and seek keep the reported state honest and restart the producer with the expected arguments.

cases.name: etaf-ascii-video-tests-resume-seeks-instead-of-catching-up
cases.purpose: Pausing freezes the position and resuming restarts the producer with an explicit seek instead of fast-forwarding to catch up.

cases.name: etaf-ascii-video-tests-resizes-canvas
cases.purpose: A grid change republishes the canvas shape, restarts the producer with the new scale, and window fitting keeps the canvas inside the window.

cases.name: etaf-ascii-video-tests-rejects-invalid-sources
cases.purpose: Unsupported sources, an explicit graphics mode and a missing ffmpeg signal user-error and leave no mounted buffer behind.

cases.name: etaf-ascii-video-tests-finishes-at-end
cases.purpose: A producer that runs out of frames ends the player, keeps the last picture, and plays again from the start.

cases.name: etaf-ascii-video-tests-documented-keys-reach-player
cases.purpose: The documented keys drive the player through the command loop instead of the renderer's own keymap, and closing leaves no buffer.

cases.name: etaf-ascii-video-tests-color-half-blocks
cases.purpose: Color mode publishes half-block cells with the predicted foreground and background colors per cell and switches back to density characters when disabled.

cases.name: etaf-ascii-video-tests-streams-http-url
cases.purpose: An HTTP(S) URL reaches ffmpeg as a stream with reconnect options while non-HTTP schemes are rejected.

cases.name: etaf-ascii-video-tests-plays-demo-with-real-ffmpeg
cases.purpose: The built-in demo plays through a real ffmpeg when one is installed, gated so other machines still run the fixture scenarios.
